items.information: Pre-payment is compulsory for Online Registration which closes on 16th September. On the spot registration will be available from 8:00 to 8:30 A.M. on 24th September. No exceptions will be entertained. Visit [Registration Procedure Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LordOfTheMinx2017#2241-registraton-procedure-and-payments) for Details. The winner of Pyraminx event will be declared the competition winner.

items.information: There is a limit of 60 competitors. At a certain point we'll send an email to confirm your participation; competitors who don't confirm within the date specified in that email will be deleted. Remember to check your inbox 1-2 weeks before the competiton. [![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/yztC4Jt.png) Clicka qui per il sito web in italiano](https://cubingitaly.org/verona-17)
